Home›Services›Tree Surgery

Our NPTC-qualified tree surgeons carry out crown reductions, crown thinning, deadwooding, formative pruning and complete tree removals with rigorous attention to safety. All work complies with BS3998 and relevant planning legislation, including TPO and conservation area restrictions. We work across residential, commercial and public sector sites — from single trees in domestic gardens to complex multi-stem specimens in sensitive environments.

Tree removal may be necessary to safeguard your property and loved ones. Dead or dying trees can pose a risk by potentially falling and damaging property or injuring people. Trees growing too close to buildings or power lines could cause structural damage. Our expert arborists ensure every job is done safely, efficiently, and with minimal disruption.

Home›Services›Site Clearance

Beechwood Trees & Landscapes offers expert tree and vegetation clearance — from looking after individual trees to managing entire woodlands. We use a modern fleet of equipment including excavators, wood chippers and stump grinders to complete projects safely and efficiently. We provide a national service using specialist plant and machinery operated by our experienced team.

If required, our arboricultural consultants survey the tree and vegetation and check for any statutory protections or ecological and wildlife restraints present on site. Once approved, we prepare a full health and safety pack for the work, including risk assessments, method statements, CoSHH documentation and other site-specific requirements.

Home›Services›Emergency Response

Storm damage and other emergencies can happen at any time, posing significant risks to people and property. Safety is paramount to Beechwood, which is why we offer a 24-hour emergency response service. Our round-the-clock team is equipped to handle urgent situations with precision and care — attending to any tree-related hazards that require immediate attention.

By using traffic management strategies and liaising with the emergency services where necessary, fallen branches or trees are quickly removed and the situation made safe. We hold framework agreements with several local authorities and housing associations for rapid response work across the UK.

Home›Services›Stump Grinding

Stump grinding can be challenging, so it's best to leave it to the experts. Our skilled team uses advanced equipment to grind stumps safely and efficiently, leaving your ground clear and ready for new landscaping projects. We handle all stump sizes across all access conditions — from small domestic gardens to large commercial and industrial sites.

Stump grinding offers numerous advantages: it clears space for new projects, prevents regrowth, improves aesthetics and removes tripping hazards. Once the stump is ground below the surface it won't regrow. Our team minimises disruption and leaves the site clean. Preparation is simple — just clear the immediate area of debris before we arrive.

Home›About Us
Our Story

25+ years of
arboricultural
excellence.

Beechwood Trees & Landscapes Ltd was founded in 1998 with a simple belief: professional tree care should be delivered with genuine expertise, an uncompromising commitment to safety, and real respect for the natural environment.

From modest beginnings, Beechwood has grown into one of the UK's most respected arboricultural and landscape management contractors — over 50 highly skilled arborists, landscapers and consultants operating nationwide.

We hold all relevant industry certifications and have earned the trust of local authorities, housing associations, universities, NHS trusts and hundreds of private clients over more than two decades of consistent delivery.

In 2022, we received the title of Arboricultural Company of the Year at the Pro Landscaper Business Awards — the UK's most prestigious recognition in our sector.

Our Values

  • Client-centred: Your requirements always come first.
  • Safety first: ISO 45001 certified. NPTC-qualified teams.
  • Environmental responsibility: We manage trees wisely and sustainably.
  • Transparency: No hidden costs. Honest quotes every time.
  • Continuous improvement: Investing in our people, equipment and processes.
